content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Fire and life-safety contracting and inspection services; no overlap with RPM's coatings, sealants or roofing products."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Manufactures roofing membranes, roof coatings and insulation sold to roofing contractors and distributors, matching RPM's roofing business."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Makes roof coatings, sealants and specialty adhesives sold to contractors and distributors, closely matching RPM's construction products."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Utility metering, test equipment and aerospace components; different products and customers from RPM's coatings and roofing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Distributor of plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products, not a manufacturer of coatings or roofing systems."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Manufactures roofing shingles and insulation sold to roofing contractors and retailers, overlapping RPM's roofing and building products."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Industrial process fluids and metalworking chemicals sold to plants, not construction coatings or consumer building products."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"HVAC equipment, UV disinfection and detection instruments; different products from RPM's coatings and roofing systems."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Locks, hinges and metal castings for equipment makers; no overlap with RPM's coatings, sealants or roofing."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Coding and marking printers and water instruments sold to manufacturers and utilities; unrelated to RPM's products."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Commercial plumbing fixtures and water coolers; different products from RPM's coatings, sealants and roofing systems."}]}
